# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Personal blog written by {{ site.author }} since 2005, covering cloud infrastructure, DevOps, open source software and personal finance. Posts are in English unless they appear under "Articoli (Italiano)". Every post is published as a rendered HTML page at the URL listed below, with its Markdown source in the GitHub repository.

## Core Content

- [About]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Who writes the blog, what he works on, and how to get in touch.
- [CV]({{ '/cv/' | absolute_url }}): Professional profile as DevOps engineer and backend developer, with a downloadable PDF.
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Contact form and links to public profiles on GitHub, LinkedIn and social networks.
- [Slides]({{ '/slides/' | absolute_url }}): Conference talks and slide decks published on the blog.
- [Tags]({{ '/tags/' | absolute_url }}): Index of every post grouped by topic tag.
- [Feed]({{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}): RSS feed of the latest posts in both languages.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/gionn/blog): Markdown source, templates and configuration for the whole site.
